inspected_lean_candidate.assessment: The legacy module deliberately defines an abstract interface. Its StandardModelData stores the desired physics assertions as Prop fields, and StatementShape asks for a conclusion package over caller-supplied data. retry_condition: An accountable source review must select and transcribe one stable theorem-level claim, including its definitions, complete assumptions, conventions, conclusion, and errata outcome. A later statement worker can then encode it with minimal pinned imports, serialize its elaborated expression, check any alternate encodings, and run the four required mutation classes.
